verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ הַגִּתִּ֑ית לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֥רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ מַה־ יְּדִיד֥וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶ֗יךָ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- hag·git·tîṯ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ miz·mō·wr mah- yə·ḏî·ḏō·wṯ miš·kə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Gittith A Psalm of the sons of Korah How lovely is Your dwelling place O LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Quão amáveis são os teus tabernáculos, Ó Jeová dos Exércitos!

verses.original: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם־ כָּלְתָ֨ה׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֪וֹת יְה֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל־ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: niḵ·sə·p̄āh wə·ḡam- kā·lə·ṯāh nap̄·šî lə·ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ Yah·weh lib·bî ū·ḇə·śā·rî yə·ran·nə·nū ’el ’êl- ḥāy
verses.literal: My soul longs even faints for the courts of the LORD my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God
verses.literalPt: A minha alma suspira e desfalece pelos átrios de Jeová; o meu coração e a minha carne clamam ao Deus vivo.

verses.original: גַּם־ צִפּ֨וֹר׀ מָ֪צְאָה בַ֡יִת וּדְר֤וֹר׀ קֵ֥ן לָהּ֮ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֪תָה אֶפְרֹ֫חֶ֥יהָ אֶֽת־ מִ֭זְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מַ֝לְכִּ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ṣip·pō·wr mā·ṣə·’āh ḇa·yiṯ ū·ḏə·rō·wr qên lāh ’ă·šer- šā·ṯāh ’ep̄·rō·ḥe·hā ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯe·ḵā Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mal·kî wê·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Even the sparrow has found a home and the swallow a nest for herself where she places her young . . . near Your altars O LORD of Hosts my King and my God
verses.literalPt: Até o passarinho acha casa, e a andorinha, um ninho para si, onde ponha os seus filhinhos, a saber, os teus altares, Jeová dos Exércitos, Rei meu e Deus meu.

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.literal: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house They are ever praising You Selah
verses.literalPt: Felizes são os que habitam na tua casa; para sempre hão de te louvar.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם עֽוֹז־ ל֥וֹ בָ֑ךְ מְ֝סִלּ֗וֹת בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
verses.literal: Blessed are those whose strength is in You whose hearts are set on pilgrimage
verses.literalPt: Felizes são os homens cuja força está em ti, em cujos corações há as estradas para Sião.

verses.original: עֹבְרֵ֤י׀ בְּעֵ֣מֶק הַ֭בָּכָא מַעְיָ֣ן יְשִׁית֑וּהוּ גַּם־ בְּ֝רָכ֗וֹת יַעְטֶ֥ה מוֹרֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḇə·rê bə·‘ê·meq hab·bā·ḵā ma‘·yān yə·šî·ṯū·hū gam- bə·rā·ḵō·wṯ ya‘·ṭeh mō·w·reh
verses.literal: As they pass through the Valley of Baca they make it a place of springs even the autumn rain covers it with pools
verses.literalPt: Passando pelo vale de Baca, fazem dele um lugar de fontes; de bênçãos o cobre a primeira chuva.

verses.original: יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל־ חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: They go from strength to strength until each appears before God in Zion
verses.literalPt: Aumentam de força na viagem, cada um deles aparece diante de Deus, em Sião.

verses.original: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י הַאֲזִ֨ינָה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šim·‘āh ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ha·’ă·zî·nāh ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: O LORD God of Hosts hear my prayer give ear O God of Jacob Selah
verses.literalPt: Ouve, Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos, a minha oração; inclina os teus ouvidos, ó Deus de Jacó. (Selá)

verses.original: מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: Take notice of our shield O God and look with favor on the face of Your anointed
verses.literalPt: Olha, ó Deus, escudo nosso, e contempla o rosto do teu ungido.

verses.original: כִּ֤י טֽוֹב־ י֥וֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶ֗יךָ מֵ֫אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑י מִ֝דּ֗וּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־ רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṭō·wḇ- yō·wm ba·ḥă·ṣê·re·ḵā mê·’ā·lep̄ bā·ḥar·tî his·tō·w·p̄êp̄ bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hay mid·dūr bə·’ā·ho·lê- re·ša‘
verses.literal: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Pois vale mais um dia em teus átrios do que mil. Eu, antes, quisera estar no limiar da Casa do meu Deus do que morar nas tendas da perversidade.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ׀ וּמָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע־ ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî še·meš ū·mā·ḡên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥên wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ yit·tên Yah·weh lō yim·na‘- ṭō·wḇ la·hō·lə·ḵîm bə·ṯā·mîm
verses.literal: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield the LORD gives grace and glory He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity
verses.literalPt: Porquanto Deus Jeová é sol e escudo. Jeová dará graça e glória; jamais negará bem algum aos que andam retamente.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: O LORD of Hosts how blessed is the man who trusts in You
verses.literalPt: Ó Jeová dos Exércitos, feliz é o homem que em ti confia.
